Certainly! Here is a revised version of your text for clarity and coherence:

"The trade replay issue, where 'REPL' is reported instead of 'NEWM' to TRAX for our active trades (which are not archived in CMRS), is caused by the RH archiving story 2323911 and is impacting the #13 fix changes. The new ESP extract for #13 is sending replay messages for rebooked trades, which are updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since these are all replay messages (<SST_REPLAY> = 'Y'), RH will report them as 'REPL' to TRAX. However, these #13 replay messages will be rejected by TRAX because they have never been reported to TRAX before. In short, the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected just like other BAU replay messages, rendering the #13 changes from ESP and RH ineffective."

Let me know if you need any further adjustments!
